description_en: Retrieves all transferable agents in a Cloud Call Center instance. An agent is considered transferable if the agent is in an idle state or has a personal mobile phone number on file
description_zh: 获取呼叫中心实例中的所有可转接的坐席，其中可转接是指坐席处于空闲状态或者坐席存有个人手机号
name: ListRealTimeAgent

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance from which to retrieve users
parameters.help_zh: 待获取用户的呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id
